agora.what: Agora (agoraworld.co): social shopping app for beauty brands, London, soft-launched April 2020
agora.status_detail: The firm listed it 2020-2023; agoraworld.co no longer answers and no sale or shutdown notice was found
agora.notes: Not the Agora of the Coatue, General Catalyst or Insight books (Agora Inc. and agora.finance are other companies).

ambar.what: Ambar (ambar.cloud): AI-assisted development of complex enterprise applications
ambar.notes: Listed by the firm from December 2025 under Seed (deal partners Sri Ayangar and Akis Bratsos, both London); no press on the round was found, and the company site names no office. Not the Brazilian construction company of the same name.

force_stage.note: A fund position: Lakestar (G.P.) Ltd, the general partner of Lakestar I, reported 330,440 Spotify shares on its Form 13F for 2018 Q4 (filed 2021-01-25). Klaus Hommels first invested personally in 2009; the round in which the fund bought is not on record, but Lakestar I dates from 2013, when Spotify was past its Series F, so any fund purchase is a Growth entry (a later round or a secondary). No announcement names it: cite_pending.
